page.layout: One column of running text, with the printed page number and running head at the top. Left margin: vertical marginal title "IESVITARVM." read bottom to top. Catchword "LXII." at the bottom right.

main_text.p: modi,& peccare,vt qui suo praeiudicio sit condemnatus.Tit.3,10,11.

IESVITARVM.Abnegatio veri Christi] Fuerunt pseudoprophetae in populo, vt etiam inter vos erunt falsi Doctores, qui subintroducent haereses exitia-les,etiam Dominum qui illos mercatus est abnegantes, accersentes sibi ipsis velox exitium. 2.Pet.2,1.
Erroris efficacia]Multi sequuntur eorum exitia, per quos via veritatis blasphemabitur. 2. Pet.2,2.
Auara negotiatio ] Per auaritiam fictis sermonibus Christianos negotiabuntur. 2.Pet. 2,3.
Miser exitus ] Iis damnatio iam olim non otiatur,& horum exitiū non dormitat.2.Pet.2,3.
Impura vita ] Carnem sequentes in impura cupiditate incedunt,& dominatum despiciūt, & vt sunt audaces & sibi placentes non horrent dignitates conuitiis incessere.2.Pet.2,10.

Mentis cacitas ] Isti velut animantia rationis expertia,quae naturali impetu feruntur, fa-ctaad[?] eum finem vt eapta intereant,ea vituperantes quae ignorant, sua ipsorum corruptela interibunt.2.Pet.2,12.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fa-ctaad" at the line end (hyphenated word, probably "facta ad") is unclear; "eapta" is copied as printed. The running head is "CHARACT. IESVITIC.". The left vertical text "IESVITARVM." is a marginal title, given as a note. "LXII." at the foot is the next section number, given as a catchword. Printed "cacitas" is kept as printed. No signature visible.
